leaveOnePublisherOut.method: For each publisher, remove every channel-pair comparison containing that publisher, then recompute Spearman rank correlation across retained off-diagonal cosine pairs. No resampling; no independence assumption or inferential interval.
leaveOnePublisherOut.rangeMeaning: Minimum and maximum across these deterministic omissions; descriptive sensitivity range, not a confidence interval.

limitations: Purposive, incomplete upload samples. No channel-population mean, census or posting rate is estimated.
Uploader accounts and human practitioners are distinct. Route groups can include unresolved aliases.
The 55 pairwise observations share 11 publishers and are not independent; no p-values or confidence intervals are reported.
Twenty-five videos have eligible matched text; only 22 in publishers with at least two videos support the matched channel-matrix comparison.
Language detection and caption-track language labels are not manual content verification.
The chunk-weighting diagnostic changes only the relative contribution of a short final chunk. It supplies no human-judgment validation and does not isolate speaker composition.

chunkWeighting.method: Same masked English caption text, tokenizer, 240-content-wordpiece chunks, token-level attention-mask mean pooling and chunk L2 normalization. Alternative video vector weights each chunk by its number of content wordpieces, excluding CLS/SEP; publisher vectors still weight videos equally. No new retrieval, training, translation or speaker segmentation.
